full_text:
Riding (skill)

Description: Animal speed and stamina drain.

Introduction. Riding is a skill.

Effects. Increasing the player's riding level increases sprint speed while riding a mount by up to +25%, and reduces stamina usage when sprinting with a mount down to -50%.

Leveling up. The player gains 0.2 experience per second while sprinting when riding a Lox or Asksvin.

Notes. • Skill ID is Ride (to use with raiseskill or resetskill commands).
• Was added in the Hearth & Home update.
